Request: houseplants watering days

app "Houseplants" plant mint
table plant name text, days_gap num 1..60 = 3
table water plant ref plant
each plant sort name
  row card
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      "Water every" it.days_gap "days" faint
    if(due(it.water, it.days_gap), "Water today", "OK") bold color if(due(it.water, it.days_gap), warn, good)
    button "Watered" tap add water plant = it
form plant, "Add plant"

Request: Cooking log for my weekly meals: dish name, date, who ate, ingredients used with quantity, and a rating from 1 to 5. Show my top rated dishes and dishes I have not cooked in over a month.

app "Cooking Log" food mint
table cook dish text, who text, rating num 1..5
table ingredient cook ref cook, item text, qty text
form cook, "Log a meal"
form ingredient, "Add ingredient used"
"Top rated" head
each cook sort rating desc top 5
  row card
    it.dish grow
    it.rating "stars" bold
"Not cooked in over a month" head
each cook by dish
  if since(it) > 30
    row card
      it.key grow
      since(it) "days ago" color warn
"History" head
each cook sort at desc as c
  stack card gap 0
    c.dish bold
    c.at "- ate:" c.who faint
    each c.ingredient
      it.item it.qty faint

Request: Track my revision for CSS exam: subject, topic, hours studied, confidence 1-5, and show weakest topics at the top.

app "CSS Revision" school ocean
table topic subject text, name text, hours num 0..500, conf num 1..5
"Weakest topics" head
each topic sort conf top 5
  row card tap edit it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      it.subject it.hours "h" faint
    "Confidence" it.conf bold color if(it.conf <= 2, bad, ink)
form topic, "Add topic"
"All topics" head
each topic sort conf
  row card tap edit it
    it.subject it.name grow
    it.conf

Request: My tuition centre has 40 students. Record each student's name, class, monthly fee, date paid, and discount. Mark who has not paid this month, and show a list of defaulters I can read out to the parents.

app "Tuition centre" school ocean
table student name text, class text, fee money, discount money = 0
table payment student ref student, amount money
let unpaid = count(student, count(it.payment month) = 0)
unpaid "students have not paid this month" head color if(unpaid > 0, warn, good)
stat sum(payment.amount month), "collected this month"
"Defaulters" head
each student sort name as s
  if count(s.payment month) = 0
    row card
      s.name bold grow
      s.class
      s.fee - s.discount
"All students" head
each student sort name as s
  row card gap 1 tap edit s
    stack grow
      s.name bold
      s.class "fee" s.fee "discount" s.discount faint
    if count(s.payment month) > 0
      "Paid" last(s.payment.at) color good
    else
      button "Paid" tap add payment student = s, amount = s.fee - s.discount
form student, "Add student"

Request: A two column scorecard for a kabaddi match with team names, points, and a button for each raid

app "Kabaddi" game ink
table raid team pick A|B, pts num 0..7 = 0
setting team_a text = "Team A" "Team A name"
setting team_b text = "Team B" "Team B name"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center gap 1
    team_a head
    sum(raid.pts where team = A) big huge
    button "Raid point" tap add raid team = A, pts = 1
    button "Bonus point" tap add raid team = A, pts = 2
    button "Super raid" tap add raid team = A, pts = 3
    button "Empty raid" tap add raid team = A, pts = 0
  stack card grow align center gap 1
    team_b head
    sum(raid.pts where team = B) big huge
    button "Raid point" tap add raid team = B, pts = 1
    button "Bonus point" tap add raid team = B, pts = 2
    button "Super raid" tap add raid team = B, pts = 3
    button "Empty raid" tap add raid team = B, pts = 0
button "Undo last raid" tap remove last(raid)

Request: I want to track my progress learning to drive

app "Learning to drive" car ocean
table lesson mins num 10..240 = 60, skill pick Parking|Reverse|Roundabout|Highway|Night|Traffic = Parking, confidence num 1..5 = 3, note text?
setting test_hours num = 40 "Practice hours goal"
goal sum(lesson.mins) / 60, test_hours, "hours practised", "h"
"Confidence by skill" head
each options lesson.skill as s
  row gap 1
    s grow
    round(avg(lesson.confidence where skill = s)) "/ 5" bold
form lesson, "Log lesson"
trend lesson sort at, it.confidence
list lesson by day

Request: I keep losing my keys and papers, make something so I stop

app "Where is it" key plum
table thing name text, place text, kind pick Keys|Papers|Other = Other
state q text = ""
field q "Search"
each thing where has(name, q) or has(place, q) sort name as t
  row card tap edit t swipe remove t
    stack grow
      t.name bold
      t.place faint
form thing, "Put something away"

Request: homework tracker for three kids: subject, due date, done or not, and weekly score

app "Homework" school ocean
table kid name text
table hw kid ref kid, subject text, due date, done bool
each kid as k
  let wk = count(k.hw where due >= today - weekday(today) + 1 and due <= today - weekday(today) + 7)
  let wd = count(k.hw where done = yes and due >= today - weekday(today) + 1 and due <= today - weekday(today) + 7)
  stack card gap 1
    row
      k.name head grow
      "Week score" round(wd * 100 / wk) "%" bold
    each k.hw where done = no sort due as h
      row gap 1
        toggle h.done
        h.subject grow
        h.due small color if(h.due < today, bad, muted)
form kid, "Add child"
form hw, "Add homework"

Request: journal with moods over time, search and a writing streak

app "Journal" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
"How are you feeling?" head
row gap 1
  each ["Awful", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
    stack grow align center tap set d.mood = index + 1
      draw width 44
        circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft)
        rect 30, 74 - 12 * index, 40, 8 + 12 * index fill bg radius 3
      it tiny
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
row gap 2
  stat streak(entry), if(count(entry today) > 0, "day streak, including today", "day streak; write today to keep it")
  stat count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0), "of 14 days written"
row gap 1
  each days last 14 days
    box grow height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(entry on it) > 0, accent, soft)
"Mood this week" round(avg(entry.mood week)) "vs" round(avg(entry.mood prev week)) "last week" faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
list entry where has(note, q) by day
"Saved on this device only." faint

Request: khata book to record who owes me and who I owe, with totals per person

app "Khata" wallet slate
table person name text, phone text?
table entry person ref person, amount money, kind pick Gave|Got, note text?
"People owe you" sum(entry.amount where kind = Gave) - sum(entry.amount where kind = Got) big
each person as p
  let bal = sum(p.entry.amount where kind = Gave) - sum(p.entry.amount where kind = Got)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "you owe") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
    "Last entry" last(p.entry.at) faint
form person, "Add person"
form entry, "Add entry"
list entry by day
